title: Smt Krishna Devi v. State of U.P.
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Hon'ble Vivek Kumar Birla, J. and Hon'ble Dr. Yogendra Kumar Srivastava, J.
disposition: Disposed; 6.14 instalment plea to be considered on merit
headnote: Writ challenging a demand letter of 19 November 2022 and seeking recovery in instalments was disposed of without any examination of the merits. Noting delay of 651 days, the Division Bench left the petitioner at liberty to apply within two weeks under clause 6.14 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005, for an instalment facility, to be considered by the Executive Engineer, Electricity Distribution Division I, Moradabad, on its own merit. She may also avail a one-time settlement if one is available.
facts: Smt Krishna Devi approached the Allahabad High Court against the State of Uttar Pradesh and electricity officials, seeking to quash a demand letter dated 19 November 2022 issued by the Executive Engineer, Electricity Distribution Division I, Moradabad, and the recovery proceedings based on that letter. She also asked that the amount under recovery be received in easy instalments. The writ was instituted 651 days after the demand.

holding_units.holding: The writ, which sought quashing of the demand letter dated 19.11.2022 and recovery in instalments and was delayed by 651 days, is disposed of without consideration of the merits, with liberty to the petitioner to apply within two weeks under clause 6.14 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. The Executive Engineer, Electricity Distribution Division I, Moradabad, shall consider and decide that application on its own merit.

principle_tags.application: The Court treated clause 6.14 as the route for an instalment facility on the impugned recovery and directed the Executive Engineer to consider such an application on its own merit, without granting instalments or quashing the demand in the writ.

not_decided.point: Merits of the demand letter dated 19.11.2022 and the recovery proceedings
not_decided.note: The Court expressly recorded that it had not considered the merits.

not_decided.point: Whether an instalment facility under clause 6.14 should be granted
not_decided.note: Left to the Executive Engineer to consider and decide on the application's own merit.

not_decided.point: Whether a one-time settlement scheme is available and applicable
not_decided.note: Liberty reserved only if such a scheme exists.
